title: OddRig rig (oddrig/1)
description: A 2D skeletal character rig authored entirely by code (no GUI editor): skeleton with standard humanoid bone names, slots (draw order), skinned mesh attachments with per-vertex weights, multi-angle head views, a face description (eyes / mouth / visemes / expressions), a hand-pose set, anchors for IK, secondary physics and clip-library inheritance. Coordinates are rig pixels (y down). Bind pose = bone world positions with zero rotation; animation is local (rot, tx, ty, sx, sy) deltas about each bone's own position.

slug.description: character id; matches the graph slug (freaks/<slug> or characters/<slug>)

unit.description: retarget unit = distance between upper_arm_r and upper_arm_l (shoulder width). Clip translations are in units, so one clip fits every body.

art_bottom.description: where the drawing stops; framing keeps it below the frame

naming.description: Standard humanoid names. Required: root, hips, spine, chest, neck, head, shoulder_{r,l}, upper_arm_{r,l}, lower_arm_{r,l}, hand_{r,l}. _r = the character's right (screen-left in a front view). Optional secondary chains (tie_0.., hair_0.., beard_0.., tail_0..) are marked secondary:true.

set.description: standard hand set; clips switch with hand_<side>.pose step keys

views.description: head view angles. yaw -1 = profile facing screen-left, -0.5 = 3/4, 0 = front, +0.5/+1 mirrored. Renderer picks the two views around the current yaw and crossfades in a narrow band at the midpoint; inside a view, per-vertex depth gives parallax.

eyes.description: procedural eyes drawn inside each view's painted eye mask (keeps occlusion + the painted outline): iris/pupil gaze, slit pupils, upper/lower lids, blinks

mouth.description: jaw = the painted lower jaw slides down per column along the detected mouth line (hinge-aware for 3/4 views); vector = painted mouth painted out with sampled surround colour, vector mouth drawn

visemes.description: Rhubarb Lip Sync shapes (A-H + X), mapped to open/wide/round/teeth/tongue

expressions.description: expression set: lid, lid tilt, lower lid, brow lift/tilt (mesh warp of the brow region), smile, pupil size, asymmetry

anchors.description: named IK targets bound to a bone: [x, y, bone]. Standard: tie_knot, chest_center, belly, chin, lapel_r, lapel_l

physics.description: secondary motion: damped angular springs driven by parent acceleration (follow-through). hand_* wrist drag and head lag are added by the runtime.

limits.description: character movement limits, e.g. {movement: 0.3}; the graph profile.movement scales clip amplitude

overrides.description: per-character clip overrides: {clip_name: {tracks: {...}, ...}} merged over clips/<name>.json

provenance.description: sheets used, builder, landmark report (which detector found what)

kind.description: head_views: renders face.views; hand: swaps hands.by_side[side][pose]

image.description: texture path relative to the rig dir

origin.description: rig position of texture pixel (0,0) (unrotated attachments)

weights.description: per vertex: [[bone, w], ...] (<=4, sums to 1). A parent/child pair is skinned by rotational blend (child's local delta scaled by w) so bends keep volume; other mixes use linear blend skinning.

depth.description: head views: 0 at silhouette .. 1 deep inside; drives turn/pitch parallax

grip.description: hand attachments: grip point relative to the wrist; IK aims it at the target

coef.description: mouth line y = a x^2 + b x + c (rig coords)
